newsitem.title: USA: Xerox increases prices on selected printers.
newsitem.headline: Xerox increases prices on selected printers.

text.p: Xerox Corp. said Tuesday it will raise prices on selected high-speed printing systems products in the United States.

Selected 50 page per minute and faster printers will cost commercial customers 3 percent to 7 percent more as of Jan. 1 The products include the 4050, 4850, 4090, 4890, 4135 and 9700 product families, Xerox said. Sales prices on selected software solutions will increase by 5 percent.
Increases for contract and governmental customers will be effective at their next contract renewal, Xerox said.
Rochester, N.Y.-based Xerox's stock was unchanged at $47.25 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
